name: Collins 2014 C6: 40 Hz modulated both sides, then hippocampal right (Shiva God Helmet, 40 min)
origin: Todd Murphy, 'God Helmet Sessions for the Shiva Neural System' v1H; tested in Persinger's lab, Laurentian University (Collins 2014, MA thesis, ch. 4)
summary: Condition 6 of Collins's 2014 test (Persinger's lab) of Todd Murphy's Shiva God Helmet sessions: the '40 Hz Modulated' signal over both sides for 20 min, then the 'Hippocampal' signal over the right side for 20 min, on four coils per side. Both signals are rebuilt: the vendor's files are not published. The thesis reports no effect specific to this condition.
notes: Collins 2014, condition 6 of 8 in the vendor's Shiva God Helmet software v1H, 3 students per condition: '40 Hz Modulated Bilaterally' then 'Hippocampus Right', 20 min each (p.69 [60], p.71 [62]). Four solenoids per side sat 5 cm apart vertically and 8 cm horizontally (p.69 [60]); C5, TP7, T9h, FFT7 and their mirrors are this project's reading of the photo (p.22 [13]). Chapter 4 names the signals without numbers (p.70 [61]) and the vendor's files are unpublished: both are rebuilt. '40 Hz Modulated' is rebuilt as a 40 Hz sine, phase-modulated 5 times a second and stepped every 100 ms; the modulation and the step are this project's choices. 'Hippocampal' is the primed burst drawn in Corradini 2014 Fig. 2 (p.103 [92]): 5-ms pulses at 0, 150, 164, 178 and 192 ms, five times in 1 s, then 4 s of silence. Rate, pause and the 200-ms step are this project's choices. In the primer one left-right pair is on at a time, and the right side is reversed so that the pair's field points through the head ('a field is generated between them', p.68 [59]). The thesis states 1-2 uT in the centre of the cap, by power meter (p.69 [60]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At 1.5 uT one coil gives about 0.05-0.09 uT at the head centre (extrapolated). The thesis reports no effect specific to this condition (p.73 [64], p.79 [70]). No sham arm, experimenter blinding not reported (p.68 [59], p.71 [62]); not repeated. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Not for people with epilepsy or a seizure history; stop on fear, anger, headache or distress.
setting: Seated in a comfortable chair, eyes closed, in a quiet, dark room (the thesis used a shielded acoustic chamber), told that a field may or may not be on. The thesis recorded 19-channel EEG every 5 min and gave the Personal Philosophy Inventory before and a 20-item exit questionnaire after.
schedule: One 40-min session per person in the thesis. For a self-test, run it against sham with the app's Blind option and fix the measure in advance (the thesis effect: right-frontal high-beta at 35 min).
source: Collins 2014 (title page dated 2013), Quantitative differences in participants exposed to patterned, weak-intensity electromagnetic fields: investigating the Shiva, MA thesis (Psychology), Laurentian University, ch. 4 and Table 3 (the 289-point amygdaloid file of the 64-coil study in ch. 2) https://laurentian.scholaris.ca/items/16d96136-680c-4afe-8044-f9137bd01afc ; Collins 2014, full text https://laurentian.scholaris.ca/server/api/core/bitstreams/c03e0259-4b31-410f-9552-d90c9c2b81a4/content ; Murphy, God Helmet session list https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/god-helmet/koren_session_list.htm ; Murphy, Shiva: sessions used in lab experiments (the chirp's 'longer and longer gaps') https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/shiva/shiva_demo/experiment_signals.htm ; Murphy, Shiva demo: modulated 40 Hz chirp https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/shiva/shiva_demo/mod40_chirp.htm ; Corradini 2014, MA thesis, Laurentian University (Shiva hippocampal file: primer pulse, then 4 pulses 150 ms later, 1-ms points) https://laurentian.scholaris.ca/items/1455e1f3-2f1d-47b5-93cd-23713d69e651 ; Rose, Diamond, Pang & Dunwiddie 1988, primed burst potentiation (cited by Collins for the hippocampal field) ; Sculthorpe & Persinger 2003, Percept Mot Skills 97:1031 (40 Hz phase-modulated five times per second) https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15002842/ ; Granqvist et al. 2005, Neurosci Lett 379:1 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15849873/ ; Gendle & McGrath 2012, Percept Mot Skills 114:217 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22582690/
